preconditions.description: The number of routers n is an integer between 2 and 200000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n - 1 and all(1 <= p[i] < i + 2 for i in range(n - 1))
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n-1 integers p₂, p₃, ..., pₙ where each pᵢ is a valid router index (1 ≤ pᵢ < i).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == ' '.join(map(str, path)) and path[0] == 1 and path[-1] == n and len(path) == len(set(path))
postconditions.description: The output is a space-separated sequence of distinct router indices starting with 1 and ending with n, representing the unique path from router 1 to router n.

postconditions.expression: all(path[i] == path[i + 1] or path[i + 1] == p[path[i] - 1] for i in range(len(path) - 1))
postconditions.description: Each consecutive pair of routers in the path is either directly connected (i.e., path[i+1] is the parent of path[i]) or the same router (only possible if path[i] == n).
